sources.summary: What can a textile do that glass , wood , concrete , or metal cannot? Architectural composite fabrics don't replace conventional building materials . Instead, they can complement them and often add another layer of performance to the building envelope . Their application changes with context. A composite membrane can become an exterior shading system for a tropical conservatory, an interior skin that shapes acoustics and spatial experience in a museum, or part of a facade strategy that improves the environmental performance of an existing building.
